name: Perceptis
description:
Perceptis turns natural-language prompts into presentation-ready PowerPoint slides and decks, designed with 
 your organization's own templates and branding.
  Ask Claude to build a single slide or a full deck, review inline previews, refine any slide by describing the 
 change, and download the finished, fully editable .pptx — without leaving the conversation.
  Key features:
 • Generate a single slide or a complete multi-slide deck from a description.
 • Apply your organization's PowerPoint templates for on-brand layouts, fonts, and colors.
 • Edit any slide in place, or regenerate a deck slide by slide.
 • Browse the templates available to your workspace.
  Perceptis is presentation-design software: it produces editable PowerPoint design assets (slides, layouts, 
 charts) for you to finish and present. Sign in with your Perceptis account; generation is tied to your 
 organization's plan and credits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perceptis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perceptis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.perceptis.ai/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perceptis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perceptis provides these MCP tools: check_generation_status, edit_deck_slide, edit_slide, export_deck, generate_deck, generate_slide, list_templates, render_deck, and show_slide_preview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Perceptis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Perceptis in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Perceptis requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Perceptis is developed by Perceptis. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
